verdict.rationale: Kick documents the pieces of this story. Reconciliation against bank statements is a monthly close step. AI categorization leaves low-confidence transactions uncategorized for manual review, and AI transfer matching is logged under a Kick agent. An MCP/CLI surface lets an external agent query transactions, update bookkeeping with approval, and "automate month-end checks". Period locks give accountants a review-and-close step. However, nothing shows an agent running reconciliation itself end-to-end, so the full workflow appears to need human orchestration across these parts. Missing for 10: an MCP/CLI reconciliation tool or documented agent-driven statement matching, an explicit exception-report workflow, an agent-prepared close package for review, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
